closed_findings.issue: An exception from per-case close could leave no cleanup row and pass all([]).
closed_findings.resolution: Thrown close writes/retains CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE and does not mark scope idempotently closed; run appends failure before receipt publication and aborts further cases whenever cleanup is unproved.

Global/group grants/enables, other enabled principals, contradictory/duplicate toggles, undeclared grants and wildcard grants are refused.
